title: Nvidia to Buy Hugging Face for $12.9 Billion in Open-Source AI Push
summary: NVIDIA entered into a definitive agreement on September 2 to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion — $11.9B to shareholders plus $1B equity retention for employees. Hugging Face hosts 3M open-source models and 18M developers. The deal is expected to close in H1 2027, pending regulatory approval.
why: 英伟达此笔130亿美元的AI平台收购是2026年最大科技并购之一，意味着英伟达从芯片硬件向软件/平台生态全面延伸，对整个AI供应链（包括港股/A股AI相关标的）估值逻辑产生重大重塑。对持有英伟达期权的投资者，短期隐含波动率值得关注。

title: 美国8月非农就业新增16.2万大幅超预期，美联储9月加息概率突破60%
summary: 美国劳工统计局9月4日公布，8月非农就业新增16.2万人，约为市场预期5.5万的三倍，远好于7月的-2.3万，失业率维持4.1%，平均时薪环比+0.3%/同比+3.1%。强劲数据令联邦基金期货显示美联储9月加息概率升破60%。
why: 非农大幅超预期彻底逆转了市场对9月按兵不动的押注，美债收益率将重新上行，短期内对全球高估值成长股（港股科技、A股成长板块）形成压制。此前手头卖出Put的投资者需密切关注9月15-16日FOMC落地前的波动率定价变化。

title: US Equities Snap 3-Day Losing Streak on Sept. 3; Fed's Waller Flags Data-Dependent Stance on Sept. Rate Decision
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq both rallied on September 3 as the 10-year Treasury yield retreated from its multi-year high of 4.818%, and Fed Governor Waller stated the September 15-16 FOMC rate decision would hinge entirely on the August CPI print due September 11. Markets subsequently priced a ~55% chance of a September hike — a figure revised sharply upward after the September 4 blowout NFP print.
why: Waller讲话界定了本轮最核心的宏观交易窗口：9月11日CPI与9月16日FOMC。若CPI再度超预期，加息概率将进一步拉升，全球权益市场（尤其港股科技、A股成长）面临估值压缩风险；Sell Put仓位需对行权价区间做好保护。

title: Broadcom Q3 FY2026: AI Chip Revenue Triples to $16.7B (+221% YoY); Q4 Guidance Slightly Misses; FY2026 AI Revenue Outlook $58B
summary: Broadcom reported Q3 FY2026 results after the close on September 2: revenue $29.6B (+86% YoY), AI semiconductor revenue $16.7B (+221% YoY, +54% QoQ), adjusted EPS $3.32 (beat). Q4 revenue guidance of $34.8B came in slightly below consensus of $35.03B. The company raised its full-year AI revenue outlook to $58B, with FY2027 at ~$115B.
why: 博通业绩是全球AI基础设施投资景气度的重要探针。AI芯片营收三倍式增长印证超大规模云厂商Capex仍极强劲，对港股/A股AI产业链（半导体设备、封装测试）是正面佐证。Q4指引小幅不及预期提示高预期风险，对Covered Call策略适时锁定收益提供了参考。延续报道：市场仍在消化Q4指引影响。

title: Tesla Stock Falls ~6% After Cybercab Launch Event Disappoints; NHTSA Opens Safety Probe
summary: Tesla held a private Cybercab launch event on September 4 that left key autonomy questions unanswered — Musk did not attend, no livestream, only a small group of shareholders and creators under NDA. The NHTSA simultaneously announced an audit into how Tesla self-certified the Cybercab (which lacks steering wheel, pedals, and mirrors) as regulatory-compliant. TSLA fell ~6% on above-average volume.
why: 特斯拉Cybercab发布会令市场失望，加上NHTSA安全调查，短期催化剂变负面。对持有TSLA Sell Put仓位的投资者，-6%单日跌幅接近或穿越部分行权价，建议评估滚动或止损；Covered Call可趁反弹早收期权。

title: Micron Targets 2× HBM Monthly Capacity to 100K Wafers by End-2026; 12-Layer HBM4 to Hit 50% of Output
summary: Micron Technology disclosed plans to double its monthly HBM production capacity to approximately 100,000 wafers by year-end 2026, up from current levels. The company is also scaling 12-layer HBM4 products for Nvidia's next-generation AI accelerators, targeting HBM4 at up to 50% of total HBM output by year-end, to close the gap with SK Hynix (58% HBM market share) and overtake Samsung.
why: 美光大幅扩产HBM确认AI内存需求持续强劲，对SK海力士（最大HBM供应商）和美光本身的增长预期均形成正面验证。相关港股标的的AI芯片相关估值逻辑获支撑；若HBM供给最终超需，注意未来18-24个月价格走势对利润率的影响。

title: Army Awards $192M to Palantir and Anduril to Produce Eight TITAN AI Battlefield Systems
summary: The US Army Contracting Command awarded Palantir USG and Anduril Industries a combined $192 million production contract to deliver eight Tactical Intelligence Targeting Access Node (TITAN) systems — four Advanced and four Basic variants — over the next 18 months. TITAN integrates space, aerial, and terrestrial sensor data into actionable AI-powered targeting intelligence.
why: Palantir获得美国陆军TITAN批产合同，是Gotham平台军事化落地的重要里程碑，标志公司从原型阶段进入规模交付阶段。对预期Palantir赢单的多头持仓有短期正面催化；期权方面，PLTR Q2业绩后已急升，此次合同能否再触新高、进一步提升Sell Put的IV溢价值得关注。
source: The Defense Post / Breaking Defense / Axios

title: Circle Confirms Arc Mainnet Launch Sept. 16 with BlackRock, Visa, Mastercard, DTCC as Founding Validators
summary: Circle announced the founding validator cohort for its purpose-built Layer-1 blockchain Arc, set to launch publicly on September 16, 2026 — one day before the U.S. Senate's CLARITY Act cloture vote. Founding institutional validators include BlackRock, DTCC, Visa, Mastercard, ICE, Standard Chartered, MoneyGram, and SBI Group. USDC circulation stands at $73.3B with 70% of stablecoin transaction volume.
why: Circle Arc主网启动是2026年加密/金融科技最重要里程碑事件之一。传统金融机构作为验证节点加入，标志稳定币基础设施向银行级合规迈出关键一步。叠加GENIUS Act监管推进，CRCL股价年内波动性持续偏高，Sell Put可关注主网发布前后期权IV溢价机会。

title: 小米汽车IFA 2026宣布2027年进入欧洲市场，与八家德国经销商签MOU；集团同日回购180万股
summary: 小米汽车在IFA 2026柏林媒体日（9月3日）宣布将于2027年正式进入德国等欧洲市场，并与Ernst Dello、Emil Frey等八大德国汽车经销商集团签署合作备忘录，展示新一代SU7及SU7 Ultra等车型。同日，小米集团以27.4-27.48港元区间回购180万股，耗资约4938万港元。
why: 小米汽车欧洲市场计划落地是继中国市场累计交付逾70万辆后的重大出海里程碑，有助于重估小米整体估值。回购信号管理层对当前股价的信心。对持有1810.HK仓位的投资者，欧洲拓展带来中长期增长预期支撑；期权方面可关注Sell Put隐含波动率定价变化。
